title: GHO now pay later
tagline: GHO-NPL empowers you to make purchases without needing to sell your valuable crypto assets. With this payment method, you can pay later by borrowing GHO, using your existing crypto holdings as collateral.
description:
GHO-NPL empowers you to make purchases without needing to sell your valuable crypto assets. With this payment method, you can pay later by borrowing GHO, using your existing crypto holdings as collateral. This allows you to keep your cryptocurrency investments intact, while simultaneously accessing funds for your everyday needs. This service facilitate seamless crypto transactions, offering innovative solutions for both shoppers and merchants.

When a shopper reaches the checkout page, they have the option to select "GHO Now Pay Later" as their payment method. Upon choosing this option, the user is directed to log into (Account Abstraction) the GHO-NPL payment portal. Once logged in, the user is prompted to lock one of their crypto assets as collateral in order to borrow GHO for the purchasing amount. They select a crypto asset from their wallet based on the lock APY rates and specify the amount to be locked. If this amount satisfies the required collateral ratio, the user can proceed with the payment.

The transaction request is then sent to the user's wallet. The user confirms this transaction from their wallet, finalizing the purchase. The GHO amount borrowed for the purchase is transferred directly to the merchant's wallet. At any time, the user can repay the borrowed GHO, along with any accrued interest, through the GNPL payment portal. Similarly, the crypto asset used as collateral, including any interest earned, can be withdrawn back to the user's wallet.
how_its_made:
@GHO NOW PAY LATER is a decentralized application leveraging GHO, the Aave Protocol's native stablecoin. Our app is engineered to facilitate seamless crypto transactions, offering innovative solutions for both merchants and users.

System Architecture:

-  Web App for Merchants
- - gho-dash
- Web App for End Users
- - pay-on-the-gho
- - - Smart Contract for Minting
- - - - gho-minting-facilitator
- - - Smart Contract for Vaults
- - - - gho-incidence-vaults

Project Features:
GHO Minting Facilitator: Implements a contract proposed to Aave DAO for GHO liquidity.
GHO Token Integration: Integrates GHO in versatile applications including web and mobile.
Smart Contract Vaults: Utilizes vaults for new GHO use cases and order-flow level coincidences.
GHO Payment Gateway: Enables merchants to receive USD payments from crypto users via GHO.
ConnectKit Implementation: Enhances transaction signing experiences within an iframe setup.

Tech Stack:
Next.js (v14.0.4): For SSR and optimized frontend performance.
React (v18): UI library for building interactive interfaces.
Ethers.js (v6.10.0): Ethereum wallet implementation and utilities.
Wagmi (v1.4.13): React hooks for Ethereum, simplifies web3 integration.
ConnectKit (v1.6.0): Simplifies wallet connection processes.
TypeScript (v5): For strong typing and enhanced code reliability.
ESLint (v8): Ensures code quality and consistency.
